purpose: 3頭BOX候補選定のみ（4歳以上だけのレース）。点数・購入/見送り・自信度には使わない。

applies_to.race_type: pure_O: 取消・除外を除く全出走予定馬の出走表年齢が4歳以上
not_applied: 3歳以下を含むレース（3歳以下のみ・混合）: 29特徴の現行BOXのまま
2026-11-09 より前のレース（保存済み予想を再生成しない）
年齢・ソリ重量欠測馬がいるレース

model_type: linear utility u=z.beta, Plackett-Luce top-3 likelihood, L2 lambda=1.0, L-BFGS-B (scipy, maxiter 500)

feature_definitions.w_rel: sled weight minus mean sled weight of same-band actual starters in race (card)
feature_definitions.w_delta_prev: sled weight minus horse's previous-start sled weight (prior dates only)
feature_definitions.w_minus_best_top3: sled weight minus max sled weight at which horse previously finished top3 (prior dates); missing->0 + flag
feature_definitions.age_months: months from birth_date to race date (card)
feature_definitions.form_last1: normalized finish (finish-1)/(n-1) of last start, prior dates only
feature_definitions.form_avg3: mean normalized finish of last 3 starts
feature_definitions.win_rate5: wins in last 5 starts, shrunk (w+0.1)/(k+1)... implemented as (wins+prior*2)/(k+2) with prior=0.12
feature_definitions.no_history: 1 if no prior start in data
feature_definitions.class_change: ladder value(current race) - ladder value(previous start), negative = promoted to higher class; 0 + flag if ladders differ/unknown
feature_definitions.scratch_hist: log1p(#withdrawn/excluded entries of this horse in prior 180 days) -- identities only available from 2023, so 0 throughout 2022 warmup (documented bias)
excluded_from_score: official assigned-class membership tables (t262 actual membership; not used)

feature_notes.best_top3_missing: 1 if no prior top3 finish (w_minus_best_top3 then 0)
feature_notes.age_months: race date - birth date in days / 30.44; birth date from bundled official history (name match + birth year = race year - card age); no-history fallback: April 15 of (race year - age)
feature_notes.class: ladder from race name: A1=1..C2=8 (+sub/20), 2/3歳 A..D, オープン/選抜=0; class_change only if same ladder type
feature_notes.scratch_hist: withdrawn/excluded entries in prior 180 days (official history)
feature_notes.history: strictly earlier race dates only; same-day earlier races are not used

normalization.method: z=(x-mu)/sd with training-window mean/std (population std, sd<1e-9 -> 1)

box_rule.name: BOX_PL
box_rule.definition: 3-horse set maximizing sum over its 6 orders of p_i*p_j/(1-p_i)*p_k/(1-p_i-p_j)
box_rule.tickets: 6点（三連単3頭ボックス、従来と同じ）
box_rule.memrobo: メムロボブサップ出走時はメムロを含む集合のうち最大の集合（軸固定特例を維持）
box_rule.tie_break: first maximal set in lexicographic candidate order (umaban order)

not_used_for: 購入/見送りゲート（29特徴の軸past_formゲートのまま）
自信度（29特徴の軸による条件別テーブルのまま）

training.rule: all pure_O races dated < effective_from; same recipe as experiment monthly walk-forward

validation.note: walk-forward monthly, 2023-01..2026-11-08; past results do not guarantee future hit rates
